correctness.rationale: Because I(P,F_q)=D⊕J is H-stable as a direct vector-space sum, the fixed algebra is D^H⊕J^H without averaging or characteristic restrictions. Orthogonal spectral projectors P_alpha of a commuting tuple have diagonal d_alpha; u=Σ P_alpha d_alpha is a unit in 1+J^H and simultaneously conjugates the diagonal tuple to the original. The stabilizer of the diagonal tuple consists of monochromatic strict-pair orbit coefficients, so each diagonal fiber has q^{b_H(c)} points. The same unipotent orbit over algebraic closure is irreducible of dimension b_H(c) and separate diagonal fibers are clopen. Burnside gives G-orbit formula. For crowns rotations quotient to 2d-cycle with parallel edges at d=1, transfer eigenvalues 1+(2^t−1)q, 1−q give exact totient sum. Independent literal multiplication enumerated small q=2,3 chains and independently counted crown rotations m=3..5; the algebraic proof is general.
